questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] Which animal was the only animal used in the discovery of a new element?
A. Rat B. Guinea pig C. Frog
Answer: B. Astatine was created by researchers who bombarded another element, bismuth, with high-energy particles. The researchers then fed the substance to a guinea pig, whose thyroid gland filtered and concentrated the astatine because of astatine’s similarity to iodine.
questions.en: In which animal's thyroid gland was newly made astatine found concentrated, showing that the element behaves like iodine?
questions.de: In der Schilddrüse welches Tieres fand man frisch erzeugtes Astat angereichert, was zeigte, dass sich das Element wie Iod verhält?

timeline.labelEn: Corson, MacKenzie and Segrè make astatine at Berkeley by bombarding bismuth with alpha particles
timeline.labelDe: Corson, MacKenzie und Segrè erzeugen in Berkeley Astat durch Beschuss von Bismut mit Alphateilchen

source.title: The Hardest Thing To Find In The Universe – NPR (Krulwich Wonders)

questions.notes: NPR: 'some lab-created astatine was injected into a guinea pig and traces were found in the little rodent's thyroid gland'. The card's 'only animal used in the discovery of a new element' is an unverifiable superlative (and the astatine was injected per NPR, not fed), so the question asks the guinea-pig/thyroid fact itself. Astatine synthesis 1940 per Wikipedia 'Astatine'; thyroid study by Hamilton & Soley, PNAS 1940.

questions.cardText:
[Literature] Homer’s “Iliad” and “Odyssey” are epic poems that both describe:
A. The adventures and trials of the hero Odysseus
B. The events and aftermath of the Trojan War
C. The founding of the city of Rome
Answer: B.
questions.en: Which war do Homer's Iliad and Odyssey both revolve around, the Iliad telling of its final weeks and the Odyssey of a hero's homecoming after it?
questions.de: Um welchen Krieg kreisen Homers Ilias und Odyssee, wobei die Ilias von seinen letzten Wochen und die Odyssee von der Heimkehr eines Helden danach erzählt?

timeline.labelEn: Homer's Iliad and Odyssey are composed, likely around the 8th century BC
timeline.labelDe: Homers Ilias und Odyssee entstehen, wahrscheinlich um das 8. Jahrhundert v. Chr.

questions.notes: Some scholars date the epics to the mid-7th century BC.
